definitions.explanation: The process of becoming worse in quality, condition, or value over time; decay or decline.

examples.japanese: {画質|がしつ}が{劣化|れっか}した。
{電池|でんち}が{劣化|れっか}して{容量|ようりょう}が{減|へ}った。
examples.english: The battery deteriorated and its capacity decreased.

examples.japanese: {経年|けいねん}{劣化|れっか}によりゴムが{固|かた}くなった。
examples.english: The rubber hardened due to deterioration over time.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{画質|がしつ}の{劣化|れっか} - image quality degradation
・{音質|おんしつ}の{劣化|れっか} - sound quality degradation
・{経年|けいねん}{劣化|れっか} - deterioration over time, aging
・{品質|ひんしつ}の{劣化|れっか} - quality degradation
・{電池|でんち}の{劣化|れっか} - battery degradation

USAGE:
Used for both physical deterioration and abstract quality decline.

RELATED WORDS:
・{老朽化|ろうきゅうか} - aging, becoming decrepit (infrastructure)
・{腐食|ふしょく} - corrosion
・{悪化|あっか} - worsening
